prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas, equal square cells. ONLY BOTTOM LEFT and BOTTOM RIGHT are filled; TOP two cells entirely blank pure white. Attached image STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, restrained blue-charcoal ink outlines, pale watercolor, natural warm accents, white opaque background. BOTTOM LEFT: A person imagines an impossible tiny balloon lifting a huge stone, thought bubble contrasted with the grounded stone below. BOTTOM RIGHT: A peaceful tropical island with white beach, palm trees, clear blue water and a relaxed traveler in shade; idyllic earthly haven. CRITICAL: drawings SMALL and completely contained in central 65% of their bottom quadrant. Highest pixel of any bottom-row drawing is BELOW 58% of total canvas height. Lowest pixel ABOVE 95% of canvas height. Entire thought bubble and palm fronds must be fully visible with ample white gap above them. All content within its quadrant; broad empty white bands at midlines. No text, labels, caption, border, grid, watermark or logos.
review_notes: Reviewed impossible balloon-and-stone thought bubble and peaceful tropical paradise. Complete thought bubble, palm fronds and figures now have white margin above bottom-row drawings and remain within cells.
